name: registry_verification_db
notes: SQLite database (/var/lib/registry/verification.db) shared by all registry search tools for cross-referenced verification data. Supports exclusive lock only - single writer at a time. Lock file: verification.db.lock. Lock timeout: 30 seconds. All registry tools write intermediate results here during execution. Requires careful sequencing to avoid lock conflicts during parallel searches.
